data.one_liner: Play and record audio on Flutter across mobile, web and desktop.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to playback audio from assets, files, URLs, buffers or Dart streams. Also records audio to files, buffers or Dart streams with various codecs.
use_when: You need both playback and recording in the same app
You want to process live audio data via Dart streams
Cross‑platform support (iOS, Android, Web, desktop) is required
avoid_when: You only need simple playback without recording
You prefer a smaller, lightweight plugin
You need a fully GPL‑compatible license
weaknesses: Large plugin with native code, can be heavyweight
Some platform bugs (e.g., iOS buffer underflow, Android recorder regressions)
MPL‑2.0 license has a weak copyleft clause that may affect modifications
data.setup_notes: Add platform‑specific permissions (e.g., RECORD_AUDIO, WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE on Android; microphone usage description on iOS). No build_runner needed.
